yamami.logging

Logging configuration for yamami.

Provides structured logging with consistent format across all modules.

yamami.logging.get_logger(name, level=20, log_file=None, file_level=10)[source]

Get a configured logger for the specified module.

Creates a logger with structured formatting that includes timestamp, log level, logger name, and message. By default, logs INFO and above to console. Optionally can log to a file as well.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – The name for the logger (typically __name__ of the module).

  • level (int) – Console logging level. Defaults to INFO.

  • log_file (str | None) – Optional path to a log file. If provided, a file handler will be added.

  • file_level (int) – File logging level. Defaults to DEBUG.

Returns:

Configured logger instance.

Return type:

logging.Logger

Example

>>> logger = get_logger(__name__)
>>> logger.info("Processing started")
2024-01-15 10:30:45,123 - INFO - yamami.module - Processing started
